title: POLLEN DASH
oneLiner: Guide a busy bee through the garden, gather pollen, and dodge angry wasps.
mechanics: Move the bee around one screen to collect golden pollen blooms.
Wasps chase and sting the bee, costing a life on contact.
Each bloom scores points; collecting several quickly builds a combo.
More wasps appear and move faster as time passes.
lose: The bee loses all three lives after being stung three times.
scoring: Collect pollen blooms for points, with bonus points for quick consecutive pickups.
